FX-COLORAMA-001.says: The settings as the effect is added, every D-381 setting written at its start: phase from intensity round the five hues, each pixel its colour by its brightness, the empty column left empty.

FX-COLORAMA-002.says: The same written as a file from before D-381, none of its settings there: the same picture.

FX-COLORAMA-003.says: Phase from hue: red and the greys the first colour, the other colours round the ring by their hue.

FX-COLORAMA-006.says: Phase from value, the largest channel: every full colour the first colour, darker rows further round.

FX-COLORAMA-007.says: Phase from zero, shift 120, three colours: every showing pixel the second colour.

FX-COLORAMA-008.says: Interpolate off, shift 10: each pixel takes one of the five colours, none between.

FX-COLORAMA-009.says: Modify hue: each pixel takes the ring colour's hue and keeps its own saturation and lightness, so the greys stay grey.

FX-COLORAMA-010.says: Modify lightness: the ring colour's lightness, the pixel's own hue and saturation.

FX-COLORAMA-012.says: Modify red: only red from the ring colour, green and blue the pixel's own.

FX-COLORAMA-013.says: Modify none, Modify Alpha on, opacities 100, 0, 100, 30, 100: the colours kept, the covering the ring's opacity at each pixel's place.

FX-COLORAMA-014.says: Modify Alpha and Change Empty Pixels on: the empty column worked too, as black, so it turns the first colour at full covering.

FX-COLORAMA-015.says: Phase from alpha, two colours, opacities 100 and 0, Modify none and Modify Alpha on: a curve on the covering; the solid pixels stay solid, the half-covered column nearly clear.

FX-COLORAMA-016.says: Matching RGB, red, tolerance 30, softness 20: red and the colours near it change, fading out with distance; the rest stay.

FX-COLORAMA-017.says: Matching hue, yellow, tolerance 10, softness 10: the yellows and the orange in part; greys never match by hue.

FX-COLORAMA-018.says: Matching chroma, the skin tone, tolerance 5, softness 15.

FX-COLORAMA-019.says: FX-COLORAMA-016 with Composite Over Layer off: the pixels not matched go clear, the matched ones alone.

FX-COLORAMA-021.says: Matching tolerance keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear, softness 10, matching white: more and more of the layer changes.

FX-COLORAMA-022.says: Opacity 3 keyed from 100 at frame 0 to 0 at frame 4, Modify Alpha on: the pixels at the third colour fade.

FX-COLORAMA-023.says: FX-COLORAMA-009 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-COLORAMA-024.says: Add Phase layer `phase`, from its red, add mode wrap: each pixel's place moves on by the layer's red under it, less where it is half covered.

FX-COLORAMA-025.says: Add mode clamp: the sum held at 1, the first colour.

FX-COLORAMA-028.says: An Add Phase layer in a file from before D-381, no add phase from: the layer's intensity is added, as get phase reads it.

FX-COLORAMA-029.says: Mask layer `mask`, by luminance: the left full Colorama, the middle part way, the right untouched where the mask is clear and half where it is half covered.

FX-COLORAMA-030.says: Masking by inverse luminance: the other way round.

FX-COLORAMA-031.says: Masking by alpha: the grey middle counts as fully there.

FX-COLORAMA-032.says: Masking by inverse alpha with Composite Over Layer off: only the right of the layer shows.

FX-COLORAMA-033.says: Add Phase and mask layers together, add mode screen, masking by luminance.

FX-COLORAMA-034.says: Mask layer `ghost`, not a layer of the composition: no mask, the whole of FX-COLORAMA-001, with EFFECT_LAYER_MISSING each frame.

FX-COLORAMA-035.says: Get phase "Hue": the word is exact, so a capital is not it. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-COLORAMA-036.says: Add phase from "brightness", which is not a choice. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-COLORAMA-037.says: Add mode "multiply", which is not a choice. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-COLORAMA-038.says: Interpolate "yes", which is not a choice. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-COLORAMA-039.says: Opacity 3 at 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-COLORAMA-040.says: Modify "rgb", which is not a choice. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-COLORAMA-041.says: Change empty "yes", which is not a choice. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-COLORAMA-042.says: Matching mode "lab", which is not a choice. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-COLORAMA-043.says: Matching colour "white", not written as #rrggbb. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-COLORAMA-044.says: Matching tolerance -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-COLORAMA-045.says: Mask layer 5, a number, not the name of a layer. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
